sections.heading: D — Rules of the Road
sections.markdown:
## D — Rules of the Road
Accuracy scope: Rules of the Road facts use the pinned official PDF and one physical page per fact; original phrasing preserves actor qualifications, exceptions and modal verbs.
The opposing-arrival paragraph says one driver signals a turn without specifying left or right, and its adjacent figure does not resolve that scope. No universal turn-versus-straight rule is asserted from that ambiguity. [A48]
Official pixels were inspected for sign shapes/symbols, work-zone controls, route examples, lane markings and turning/crosswalk diagrams; meanings were not inferred from text labels alone. [A51] [A52] [A53] [A54] [A55] [A57] [A58] [A59]
Specific route-marker graphics are labeled illustrations, not claims that every current Maine marker uses that design. Example sign numerals are not exported as universal speeds or distances. [A54]
The large-vehicle turning illustration does not supply a dimensional or exact swing-clearance rule, so no such value is inferred. [A57]
Confidence process: every drafted fact received a same-model source-context check before submission; independent coverage and hallucination QA remain pending.
Officeholders, telephone numbers and changing administrative details are excluded from stable learner statements. No source attribution is a legal or clinical signoff.
